title: Safe Deposit Boxes: Reservations, the Branch Waitlist and the Start of a Lease
content:
At Piedmont Crescent Bank, Safe Deposit Boxes are not handed out on the spot. A size is reserved at a particular branch, the reservation waits on that branch's list, and a lease begins only when a box of that size is offered and taken.

## Terms by box size

| Box size | Youngest age to reserve (whole years) | Order of offers | Days an offered box is held | Contents insured by the bank |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 18 | By reservation date | 10 calendar days | No |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 18 | By reservation date | 10 calendar days | No |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 18 | By reservation date | 10 calendar days | No |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 18 | By reservation date | 10 calendar days | No |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 18 | By reservation date | 10 calendar days | No |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 18 | By reservation date | 10 calendar days | No |

## Placing a reservation

- **Age.** On the day the reservation is made the customer must already be 18 years old or more. The age comes from the date of birth held in the bank's customer record, not from what the customer states. As a hypothetical boundary, a customer whose eighteenth birthday falls on the reservation date meets the age; one whose eighteenth birthday is the following day does not.
- **Branch.** A size can be reserved only at a branch whose vault has that size installed.

A reservation that has not become a lease may be cancelled by the customer, which closes it.

## Waitlist order

Offers go out by reservation date, the oldest reservation receiving the first offer. When a box of a given size frees up at a branch, it is offered to the customer next in line for that size at that branch, and no customer is ever offered a box ahead of someone who reserved the same size at the same branch on an earlier date.

## How long an offer stays open

Once a box is offered, it is held for that customer for 10 calendar days. The count begins on the day following the offer date, which is day 1. The customer can take the box on any date up to and including the offer date advanced by 10 days; if that date passes without acceptance, the reservation lapses and closes. The offer date in the rental record is the authority for this count.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical offer date of 3 June):**

| Date the customer accepts | Day of the hold | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 12 June | Day 9 | Within the hold |
| 13 June | Day 10, the last day | Within the hold |
| 14 June | Past day 10 | Hold expired; the reservation has lapsed |

## What happens when an offered box is taken

When the customer accepts, the lessee signs the lease, the bank issues the box's keys, the key deposit is charged to the rental as a key-deposit service charge, and rent for the first rental year is charged on the date the lease starts. The rental then stands as active.

## Contents coverage

For every size, the bank does not insure what a customer keeps in the box. A customer who asks about covering the contents is directed to their own insurer.
